verdict.rationale: The only explicit bulk operations in the evidence, such as bulk-creating virtual cards or users, run through third-party automation platforms (Pipedream via an emailed CSV, Workato). Those are external tools looping over single-item Brex API calls, not a Brex-native bulk capability. Brex's own features are single-item endpoints, filtered list reads, and AI agents that automatically apply policies to transactions; none is a user-invoked operation across many selected items, so this is adjacent evidence only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
